description: Local test site per SMP-V03-01 (a real HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 with fictional test accounts: login with failure counting and lockout, MFA with a site-side simulator reachable only out-of-band, session lifecycle) plus the V03 web-login driver that classifies outcomes and takes credentials/MFA codes only through the platform's sensitive pending-input channel (P2-6). No real site or credential is involved.
name: @infosec/test-site

scripts.pretest: npm --prefix ../contracts run build && npm --prefix ../platform run build && tsc -b .
